# vendor/

Third-party trees. `pq-cli` is **reference only**. `stb_easy_font.h` and `stb_image.h` are linked by `host/gfx.c`.

## pq-cli

Faithful Progress Quest logic (MIT), cloned from https://github.com/rr-/pq-cli
which itself ports https://bitbucket.org/grumdrig/pq (original source release 2011).

Use it to steal *ideas* (task state machine, encumbrance → market, spell ranks,
11 armor slots, plot acts). Do **not** copy word lists, joke races, or spell
names into `app/`. Tami’s names stay original folklore.

Original game: http://progressquest.com/
